Join with compound_structures to get canonical_smiles. Return distinct canonical_smiles.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT cs.canonical_smiles FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4822' AND ass.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens'
